svg.aria-label: Both codecs let each thread find its own data without asking a neighbour. With PFOR at b = 3, threads t0 to t7 start at bits 0, 3 to 21 at once and decode 3 5 2 7 4 6 1, and t7 adds its exception bits 1011 shifted by 3 to decode 90. In PivCo, on the root bitmap 0 1 0 1 0 1 0 0 each thread counts the 1s before it, so t1, t3 and t5 read child slots 0, 1 and 2 and the threads decode a b a c a b a a.
svg.text: 1 pfor gives every value b = 3 bits, so thread t starts at bit 3 x t
2 t7 is an exception, its high bits 1011 wait in a side list
3 in pivco, thread t counts the 1s before it in the bitmap
4 a thread holding a 1 reads the child at slot = its count
pfor, offset = slot x b. pivco, slot = count of 1s before you.
